c-clamp: a clamp in the shape of the letter C
c-horizon: beneath the B-horizon and above the bedrock; consisting of weathered rock
c-note: a United States bill worth 100 dollars
c-ration: a canned field ration issued by the United States Army
c-section: the delivery of a fetus by surgical incision through the abdominal wall and uterus (from the belief that Julius Caesar was born that way)
